In USDA, we reuse Quantum Mechanics in modelling both Micro-Environment Intelligence and Micro-Agent Intelligence of ASI; Based on General Relativity, we make a T-Symmetry extension allowing time reversal and a 4-Dimensional Pseudo-Riemannian Manifold based SpaceTime Model to N-Dimensional GeneSpace in modeling both Macro-Environment Intelligence and Macro-Agent Intelligence of ASI. We discover that intelligence is the natural or artificial mapping of multiverse with bio-physical geometry effect, this not only solves the blackbox puzzle of AI, but also paves the way in achieving ASI through USDA originated from Electronic Design Automation (EDA) - From Algorithm to System. Of course, our Multiverse Endeavor on quest for USDA will never stop from there.
